section.title: Experience capture
section.subtitle: Turn corrections and reviews into reusable experience: candidates, skill drafts, skill self-repair and rollback
field.enabled.label: Enable experience capture
field.enabled.help: When off: no more correction candidates, no automatic review, and neither tool writes to disk. Candidates and skills already on disk stay exactly as they are.
field.reviewMinIterations.label: Tool calls per round before an automatic review
field.reviewMinIterations.help: Counted as tool calls in this round, not user turns (hermes' convention). 0 turns the automatic review off. Default {count}.
field.requireApproval.label: Ask me before a skill is written
field.requireApproval.help: When on, every skill create or rewrite raises an approval card; with nobody to answer it is treated as a refusal, and the draft goes to the candidate list for you to promote.
field.retentionDays.label: Candidate retention (days)
field.retentionDays.help: Candidates older than this are trimmed on the next write. Default {count} days.
field.maxCandidates.label: Candidate cap
field.maxCandidates.help: The oldest ones go first once over the cap. Default {count}.
field.skillsRoot.label: Skill folder
field.skillsRoot.help: Skills are written here (archive folder {archive}, currently {count} entries, moves in only); click the path to copy it.
field.paths.label: Candidates and ledgers
field.paths.help: Only these two roots are written, nothing else: {roots}.
field.skills.label: Skills right now
field.skills.help: Aging goes active → stale (no hit for 14 days) → archived (30 days, moved not deleted); only skills with created_by: agent that are not pinned are touched.
field.curate.label: Tidy up now
field.curate.help: Run the aging pass and archive once right away instead of waiting for the next trigger.
save.badReview: Enter a whole number between 0 and 200 (0 = no automatic review).
save.badRetention: Retention must be a whole number between 1 and 365 days.
save.badMaxCandidates: The cap must be a whole number between 10 and 2000.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.unknown: This section has no such button: {name}
